fact: 学琴史：外公从她 3 岁起给她上小提琴课；第一把是 1/10 琴，声音像吱吱响的玩具，她厌恶它；五岁生日外公带她们去密歇根大道的琴行，替她挑了 ½ 号 Ming Jiang Zhu 和一支鲜红色碳纤维弓；琴对她太大，外公说"她长得快，很快就要挑第一把全尺寸琴"，母亲却说"We’re not in such a hurry, Richard"；父亲死后她有数周不碰琴，只因为母亲提到父亲爱听她练琴才回去
quote: My grandfather gave me violin lessons, starting when I was three. I had a 1⁄10 violin; it sounded like a squeaky toy and I despised it. … For my fifth birthday Grandpa took us to a fancy shop on Michigan Avenue and helped me choose a ½ size Ming Jiang Zhu and a bright red carbon-fiber bow. The violin was too big for me. “She’s growing fast,” … My mother said, “We’re not in such a hurry, Richard.” … After my dad died I wouldn’t touch it for weeks. I only went back to it because Mama happened to mention how much Dad had liked hearing me practice.

quote: One day when I was six my grandfather lost his patience with me during a lesson and yelled. … I cried all the way home in the car. Mama said, “If you don’t want to play, you don’t have to.” … Sometimes there is a day I want to revisit, time travel for a reason, not random or pointless: that day is one of those days. … I find myself on our kitchen floor, naked on the warm linoleum next to the fridge. Mama helps me up. … “We just got home from a lesson. Your grandpa gave you a hard time because you aren’t practicing. You’re in a mood.”

fact: 她让母亲另找一位老师：别停外公的课、也别告诉外公；在黄色便笺上写下 Terryl D. Lane 和电话；她解释自己是在密歇根大道听他卖艺（busking）拉比贝尔《G 小调帕萨卡利亚》时认识他的——那是在未来、街上几乎无人的时候，他叫她名字、要她立刻戴口罩；安排是每周三下午五点来家里、母亲几乎总会留他吃饭，Terryl 善于保守秘密；母亲问这是不是 causal loop，她说她讨厌因果闭环但事实如此
quote: “Find me another teacher. Don’t stop sending me to Grandpa, and don’t tell him, but find someone who knows how to teach.” … I write Terryl D. fact: 第二段（Clare 叙述）：2009 年 6 月 16 日是 Henry 四十六岁生日；Clare 在 Henry 童年的卧室等 Alba 下课，房里保留着他少年时的书（漫画、Bradbury、Lovecraft、西部小说、古希腊罗马、Sexton、Plath、Salinger）、衣柜里还有他的衣服和淡淡气味；Richard 说 Henry 以前会裸着突然出现在公寓，死后也来过一次（"Only once … but that was enough to make me hope"）；Richard 买了四个巧克力纸杯蛋糕、紫色糖霜花是 Alba 最喜欢的；Richard 与 Alba 隔桌合奏《Der Spiegel》（"The Mirror"，回文式逆行倒影卡农，一人倒着读谱）；Clare 点出这场快乐里"看不见的英雄"是 Terryl，并想起自己小时候也在屋后草地见时间旅行者、父母从没怀疑过
quote: Today would have been Henry’s forty-sixth birthday. … a box of four chocolate cupcakes … Richard and Alba are standing across from each other at a small table, playing a duet. There’s a single page of music on the table between them and they are both playing from it, one reading it upside down, the other right side up. Richard is teaching Alba an ingenious duet called “Der Spiegel”—“The Mirror.” It’s a musical palindrome; Richard called it a retrograde inversion canon. … The invisible hero of this happy scene is Alba’s other teacher, Terryl. … my parents never suspected that I was meeting a time traveler in the meadow behind our house.
